title: US texting (A2P 10DLC)
intro: For US clients. Carriers only deliver business texts from a number registered to the business. Register the client here in four steps; after approval the AI texts from this number and replies come back into Chats.
costs: Telnyx charges on submit: brand about $4 once, campaign review $15 plus the first 3 months ($10 a month, sole proprietor $2), number about $1 a month. Approval takes 1 to 2 weeks.

brand.help: The client's business as the carriers will know it. Use the legal name and address exactly as registered with the IRS.
brand.otpHelp: Sole proprietors confirm with a code texted to the owner's mobile. Send it, then type the code the owner received (valid 24 hours).

campaign.help: What the texts are for, how people agreed to get them, and examples. Carriers reject vague answers, so keep these concrete. Prefilled for a typical client: check every line.

usecases.LOW_VOLUME: Low volume mixed (under 2,000 texts a month)

number.help: A local number the client's customers will recognise. It gets its own messaging profile that sends inbound texts to the AI.
number.none: No numbers with texting in that area code. Try a neighbouring one.

assign.help: Connects the number to the approved campaign. Texts only go out after this.
assign.waitCampaign: Possible once the campaign is approved.

off: Not switched on yet: you can fill in and look around, but nothing is sent to Telnyx and nothing is charged. It is switched on in the server settings (US_SMS_REGISTRATION_ENABLED) when the first US client signs.
